title: Download scoped product shipment ranking as PDF
description: A user downloads the current quantity-only product shipment ranking design as PDF. Add a PDF endpoint to the existing dynamic ranking controller that reruns its validated and freshly authorized preview; use a narrow Infrastructure exporter with existing PDFsharp and SimHeiPdfFontResolver. Preserve selected-column order, effective dates, Top-limited coverage and separate units, paginate wide columns and rows and show explicit empty evidence. Never include current-price money estimates, combine quantities across units or claim full source coverage. Missing fonts/render failures return a clear error and no corrupt file. The designer sends current dates/Top/fields and reports download failures; current Excel remains compatible. Development only: reuse existing ERP report services, the product-sales-ranking menu and current-user SalespersonDataScopeService; existing OperationLogMiddleware records HTTP audit. No arbitrary/model-generated SQL, permission expansion, direct table/business writes, new domain entities or persistence schema, schema/view/stored-procedure edits, migrations, production SQL or real database execution, secrets/.env/config changes, irreversible actions, production deployment or real browser acceptance. Keep unrelated work. Run focused in-memory API/service/export/UI source-contract tests and configured safe Release build/test; unavailable external environments must be marked blocked, never fabricated passed.
acceptance_criteria: PDF independently validates current fields/dates/Top and rechecks identity/menu/customer scope, using the same server-derived bounded quantity preview; revoked/invalid requests return no file.

The Infrastructure exporter preserves selected order, approved-shipment/date/Top/unit context, row/column pagination and empty evidence, omits money and cross-unit totals and fails explicitly on missing font/render error.
Designer retains current request values on PDF and surfaces errors; focused PDF/UI and Excel compatibility tests plus safe Release build/test pass.
